[purple]v26.07.29
    - Structured OOP package
    - Chafa iTerm image preview
    - Reply-to-you indicator
    - Role-based username color option
    - Persistent startup notifications
    - Synchronized local timestamps
    - Topmost upload picker
    - Message bookmarks
    - Per-channel notification sounds[/purple]

[purple]
How to Use

Navigation
    -s <server>
        Select a Discord server.
        Example: -s My Server

    -c <channel>
        Select a text channel from the current server.
        You must select a server with -s first.
        Example: -c general

    -cf <username>
        Open a direct-message conversation with a user.
        Example: -cf username

    -<
        Show older messages from the current channel.

    ->
        Return toward newer messages.

Messages
    <text>
        Send text directly to the currently selected channel.
        Example: Hello everyone

    -r <message no.> <text>
        Reply to a message. Staged uploads are included.
        Example: -r 2 I agree with this

    -e <message no.> <new text>
        Edit one of your messages.
        Running it without new text fills the input with the original message.
        Example: -e 1 Corrected message

    -d <message no. ...>
        Delete one or more of your messages.
        Example: -d 1
        Example: -d 1 3 5

    -fw <message no.> <username>
        Forward the text of a message to a user's DM.
        Example: -fw 3 username

    -y <message no.>
        Copy a message to the clipboard.
        Example: -y 4

    -p <message no.>
        Pin a message when you have permission.
        Example: -p 2

    -dp <message no.>
        Unpin a message when you have permission.
        Example: -dp 2

    -ct <message no.> <emoji>
        Add a reaction to a message.
        Emoji aliases such as :sob: are supported.
        Example: -ct 5 :sob:

    @<username>
        Mention a member from the current server.
        Typing @ opens username completion.

    :<emoji name>
        Search for an emoji using autocomplete.
        Example: :thumbs_up:

Uploads and Attachments
    -up
        Open the file-selection window above other windows and stage files.
        Staged files are sent with the next normal message or reply.

    -deup
        Remove all currently staged uploads.

    -open <message no.> [attachment no. ...]
        Download and open attachments from a message.
        Without attachment numbers, every attachment is opened.
        Example: -open 2
        Example: -open 2 1 3

    -v <message no.> <image no.>
        Preview an image attachment inside WezTerm using Chafa's iTerm format.
        Example: -v 2 1

        While viewing:
            Enter or r    Redraw after resizing the terminal
            -<            Close the preview and move to older history
            ->            Close the preview and move to newer history
            q             Close the preview

Notifications
    -ntf
    -notif
        Show stored notifications, including mentions discovered since the previous startup.
        Direct messages are treated as notifications automatically.

    -gntf <notification no.>
    -gonotif <notification no.>
        Open the channel containing a notification.
        Example: -gntf 1

Bookmarks
    -bm <message no.>
        Save a message as a persistent bookmark.
        Example: -bm 3

    -bms
        Show all saved bookmarks.

    -gbm <bookmark no.>
        Open the channel and history around a bookmarked message.
        Example: -gbm 1

    -dbm <bookmark no.>
        Delete a bookmark from the bookmark list.
        Example: -dbm 1

Miscellaneous
    -changelog
        Show the application changelog.

    -conf
        Open the configuration command placeholder.
        The interactive configuration editor is not finished yet.

    -h
    -help
        Show this help page.

    -q
    -quit
    -exit
        Close the Discord terminal client.
[/purple]
